svg.title: Product assembly and parts list
svg.text: USB-C exits left above the stand; 22 x 10 x 30 plug body stays outside. Straight 40 mm insertion and grip checked.
Rear cover: 4 x M3 x 14. PCB to carrier: 4 x M3 x 4. Do not substitute longer PCB screws.
Front gasket 0.5 mm; rear perimeter support 2 mm, compressed. Keep pressure off active glass and the FPC.
Case 182.2 x 137.2 x 18.0; nominal flex return R3.65. Disconnect USB before installing or removing the FPC.
